It is the official website for Dr. Veit, a medical professional in Brazil who specializes in aesthetic medicine and…"; Claude: "drveit.com.br Based on the domain name, drveit.com.br appears to be a Brazilian business (indicated by the .com.br domain extension) that likely operates in one of…"; Perplexity: "Drveit.com.br sells oral-care products under the Dr. Veit brand, including: · Dr. Veit Soft toothbrush with soft Dupont Tynex® bristles · Dr. Veit Interdental toothbrush,…". Saying clearly who you are and what you do in your llms.txt file, structured data and homepage gives AI assistants that read your site the right description. It does not change what a model has already learned, so results can take time to change. This row is for information and is not counted again in your score.

gaps.notes: 0% of scored test answers matched how your site describes itself and included at least one link to it.
gaps.remediation: You cannot edit ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity directly, so there is no setting that makes them link to your site. What can help is having pages worth citing: one clear page for each thing you offer, each at a single stable address with a canonical URL, that answers the question in plain text near the top. Links to those pages from independent sources, such as directories, press coverage and industry lists, can also help, because these models draw on what other sites say. Estimated effort: 2 to 4 hours.
